verdict.rationale: Statsig's access-management docs cover SSO and SCIM, and describe SCIM as managing user accounts and permissions by role. That is a thin, generic sign of role-based access control, but nothing shows restricting changes to specific flags or issuing scoped API tokens. missing for 10: per-flag or per-resource change permissions, documented role definitions within Statsig, scoped/limited-permission Console API tokens, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens

citations.quote: SCIM ensures consistent management of user accounts and permissions across those applications.
SCIM: Automatically provisions the employee’s user accounts in all necessary applications based on their role.
